title: The government's formal advice to Web Summit, as a published text
summary: Web Summit's page says the government "formally advised" against Day 2. We have the Prime Minister's words only through a press live blog (17:53) and Web Summit's own account; we have not read the advice as a text published by the government. Read at source since (row s-1111T0228): the alert situation's legal text (Despacho 13773-A/2026, Diário da República) suspends outdoor events and does not mention Web Summit; so "formally advised" has no legal text and stays the organisers' own wording.
closes: The advice on a government channel (portugal.gov.pt, the Interior Ministry), or the government saying on the record that it was given by word only.
who_answers: the Government of Portugal (the Prime Minister's office or the Interior Ministry)
